name: seis-repository-health
description: Read-only repository hygiene and public-safe health findings for SEIS.

interface.shortDescription: Find repository hygiene gaps without mutating Git.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, local-only SEIS repository review plugin that reports branch markers, tracked worktree state, governance files, CI presence, manifest coverage, and secret-risk filenames without modifying the repository.
defaultPrompt: Run a safe SEIS repository health check.
Find hygiene gaps without changing Git.
